$comment: rootDir is intentionally omitted here (every sibling package sets it). This is the only package whose TESTS import another workspace package resolved to source — @arbor/kb, used by the chain-comparison probes per ADR-027 amendment — which trips TS6059 under a package-scoped rootDir. Omitting it, together with the project references added to this package tsconfig.json, makes gate:typecheck-tests pass across all 11 packages (verified empirically; the two changes landed together and their contributions were not isolated). Revisit if a future TS version reintroduces the error.
